reviews.title: Solid Motherboard
reviews.comment: This is a solid beast purchased this open box and was worried it wouldn't work then I noticed a little green light barely flashing and it was the BIOS button whoo I press it it flashed green then stayed solid green then boom it started and kept power solid as a rock I watched the temps for a long while and honestly been a really great motherboard thank you ASUS
